items.title: 4,000MW rooftop solar ambition demands $2b fund
items.description: Bangladesh needs about $2 billion of investment, along with careful planning and skilled workers, to achieve the target of installing 4,000 megawatts (MW) of rooftop solar capacity within a year, according to energy specialists.

items.title: Exports rise 4.4% to nearly $4b in October
items.description: Bangladesh’s merchandise exports rose 4.4 percent year-on-year to nearly $4 billion in October 2026, largely driven by garment shipments.

items.title: Money worries affect 72% of workers: survey
items.description: Financial stress is increasingly affecting employees’ productivity in Bangladesh, with nearly three out of four workers saying money worries are affecting their performance, according to a new survey by MetLife Bangladesh.

items.title: IPDC to raise Tk 400cr through bonds
items.description: IPDC Finance PLC is going to raise a total of Tk 400 crore by issuing two bonds, including a green one, to institutional and private investors.
